title: Affinities
subtitle: Discover how much your profile identifies with a theme and manually adjust your preferences.
rankingEmpty: Terms from your smart tags and boosts will be ranked here.
resetConfirm: This removes every manual boost (positive and negative) and restores your learned profile. This cannot be undone.
algoResetConfirm: This clears your preference profile so recommendations start from scratch. Choose what gets wiped:
algoOptLearnedDesc: The likes/dislikes profile built from your interactions. Always cleared.
algoOptBoostsDesc: All manual term boosts (positive and negative) and their vectors.
algoOptCountersDesc: Per-feed like/dislike counters learned from your behavior.
algoOptHistoryDesc: Permanently deletes the record of your likes, dislikes, saves and reads.
algoResetHint: With an empty profile, recommendations fall back to popular and recent articles until the algorithm relearns from new interactions.
